system.description:
Your veil can now swallow inanimate objects as large as a whole house, hiding them and everything within.

You must be within 30 feet of the object, which must hold some personal significance to you (your own car or house, or a lover's house, but not a stranger's van). The object and its contents are hidden; passersby detour around it without acknowledging they are doing so. Conceal functions as Unseen Presence for purposes of detection, and like other Obfuscate powers it does not fool photographs.
